title: A stranger searches restaurants on the sign-in-free /find (the WO plugin's own Find view in public mode); the Google cost is one capped request and the picks reach the signed-in Find
steps: S1: With both switches on, POST /find/api/search {lat, lon, radiusM: 3000} with no cookie.
S2: With either switch off, call the same door and GET /find.
S3: On a shard (deploymentRole shard), GET /find and POST the door.
S4: POST bodies the door must not make: radius 2000, a stray field, both query and point, over 2 KB.
S5: From one address, search 4 times in a minute; with publicFindSearchesPerDay 2, search from three addresses; set it to 0 and search again.
S6: Let Google answer 500 with publicFindSearchesPerDay 1, then search again from another address.
S7: Read the search answer for a place named with markup, a photo and a javascript: website.
S8: Open the signed-in Find with wo-at, wo-radius and wo-pick in the address.
S9: Build the app with no dnsResolve (as production does) and search /find/api/search.
S10: Search the same point and radius signed in and on /find; then hand over three picks, one of them not in the signed-in results (a chain).
S11: Answer the public search with a short page that names a nextPageToken.
S12: Mount the public Find view with a stored search history and a granted location, then type an area, search, pick 11 rows and press Continue.
S13: Visit /find signed in, with a shard pointer, with an expired session and with none, under each switch combination; fetch the page's assets and an unknown /find/api door.
S14: Bundle the page entry and call every method of its public Api.
S15: Set the public Find limits through the operator settings and search past them; change a limit and search again on the same server.
S16: Seed published shared research for one Google place and one account's opportunity, private profile, build and demo action on it; search anonymously.
S17: Type in the public place box, pick a suggestion, and trip each suggestion fence.
S18: Search signed-in then publicly at the same point; search again from 100 m away; let the kept answer pass placesCacheDays; ask the same words and the same pick twice.

Research pressed on /find without signing in queues the shared place job by Google place id only; a place without a website gets its social page only with branch evidence; menu links become dishes with prices, and only same-row ones are verified.
S19: Research a place, then press Retry on one blocked source row (Facebook) and on Google; repeat with Google listing photos switched on.
S20: Read the operator report of each provider group with fewer than 30 calls, then with enough calls where a lower provider does better or a paid one sits ahead of a free one.
S21: Read a place's menu photos with a vision model assigned and photo-vision in the menu-items order, beside a website menu; freeze the agent bundle.
S22: Freeze an agent bundle for a place whose research is silent on some facts, then check a plan and the host QA against it.
S23: Read the logo of a place from its candidates and render the Media row in each state.
expect: S1: 200; exactly one fetch, to places:searchNearby with maxResultCount 20; no row in wo_opportunity or wo_place.
S2: the door answers 404 FEATURE_OFF with no fetch; /find redirects to /login?next=%2Fnew%2F%3Ftab%3Dtracy%3Awebsite-opportunities%26wo-view%3Dfind.
S3: 404 for both, no fetch.
S4: 400 INVALID_SEARCH for each, no fetch, and none of them counts against the address.
S5: the fourth is 429 RATE_LIMITED; the third address gets 429 DAILY_LIMIT; with 0 the answer is 429 CLOSED; Google was called only for the answered searches.
S6: 502 DISCOVERY_FAILED with one Google fetch and nothing else fetched; the next search is 429 DAILY_LIMIT.
S7: the answer is the signed-in row shape with status new, no photo name and no javascript: link.
S8: the parameters are removed from the address, the signed-in search runs once, the matching rows are selected, and no research starts.
S9: 200 with one Google call: the public routes resolve hosts.

S10: both send the same Google request and show the same places (chains hidden); after the hand-over all three picks are selected, the missing one fetched by id through places/suggest/:placeId and the place search.
S11: exactly one Google request.

S12: nothing is searched, located, restored or stored on mount; the search sends only {query, radiusM}; no image, no Map button, no row action; 10 picks at most; Continue hands on the 10 ids with the point and radius; no research call.

S13: signed-in and shard-pointer visitors get 302 to the signed-in Find with wo-at, wo-radius, wo-pick and utm_* kept and no-store; a stranger gets the page when both switches are on, else /login?next=; assets have their own MIME type and never redirect; unknown doors answer JSON 404.

S14: no @deepseek-ai module, no plugin index.tsx, styles.ts or lib/client.js, one React; only /find/api/capabilities and /find/api/search are requested; the polls stop on CHECKS_UNAVAILABLE and SOCIAL_STATS_UNAVAILABLE.
S15: defaults 10/min and 60/h per address, 60/min and 500/day per deployment; the 11th search in a minute is 429; a changed setting applies without a restart.
S16: the row reads researched with its published website check and socials; no opportunityId, siteKey, findAction, private profile, build or demo action appears.

S17: one Autocomplete call with the typing session, one Place Details call on the pick, the search goes by its coordinates; each fence answers 429 before Google and plain typing plus Search still work.

S18: one Google request serves both Finds; the nearby search is a hit costing no deployment budget, with distances from the new point; an expired answer is asked again; words and picks are asked once; the cache row holds a request hash and Google's body only.

A researched place costs nothing; a hostile body is ignored; a search-found page without branch evidence never becomes a link; a price not on its dish row stays unverified; Build demo is the only step that asks to sign in.
Each wired provider group follows the order set on /ops/wo; the default order behaves exactly as research did before.
S19: the steps card lists every source with its reason; Retry collects that source alone, charges only that source and buys no Google listing photo; a Google retry asks Place Details once more.
S20: under 30 calls the row says Not enough data yet with the count; with enough calls it shows calls, usable rate and cost, and a misorder is marked bold; nothing reorders the providers.

S21: photo dishes are unverified with source.kind photo and no price unless printed; the website dish wins over the photo; each photo read is one vision ledger row; the menu part has its summary first and the profile part no longer carries the dishes.
S22: collected values win, gaps may hold sample content flagged sample: true; a collected review keeps its words and author; QA fails only facts that contradict the research.
S23: one logo is chosen with its source and how it was recognised; no logo found offers a Retry of the logo alone.
fence: The budget buckets in rate_bucket are reserved before the one Google call and never refunded; the API door checks both UI switches itself; the client reads the hand-over once and only preselects
